# userscripts

> Public, auto-updating Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey userscripts. Each script is one self-contained `.user.js` file whose @updateURL points at this repo, so installs update themselves.

Machine-readable index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/udiverma/userscripts/main/scripts.json
Contributing (humans and agents): https://github.com/udiverma/userscripts/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Scripts

- (none yet)

## Tags

- accessibility: Readability, contrast, keyboard navigation, screen-reader fixes
- ai: Adds or improves AI / LLM features on a site
- automation: Fills, clicks, or repeats steps for you
- bulk-actions: Select, edit, or act on many items at once
- cleanup: Hides clutter, banners, upsells, or distractions
- data-export: Copies or downloads page data (CSV, JSON, clipboard)
- developer: Tools for developers: GitHub, docs, consoles, APIs
- enterprise: Business and SaaS apps used at work
- finance: Banking, accounting, budgeting, investing
- media: Video, audio, and image sites
- privacy: Blocks tracking or limits what a site can see
- productivity: Saves time or clicks on a site you use often
- shopping: Retail, prices, listings, checkout
- social: Social networks, forums, chat
- ui-tweak: Adds buttons, badges, panels, or layout changes
